A member below 50% non-null coverage on tonight's pool DROPS (presence floor); a member with fewer than 2 distinct non-null oriented values tonight is VOTE-INERT (variance floor) and is disclosed rather than hidden; a family with no surviving member is ABSENT with its reason; a row missing a family is scored on the mean of ITS present families, and a row with no family at all scores null — never zero.
